notes.title: >PATCH_7
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]Kalpel![/b][/i][/h1]
Well that was possibly the most intense few months of my life...
I've been reading every comment and review, and it's been interesting seeing how people have perceived this. I really appreciate people sharing their views and opinions too - it would worry me if I didn't get any criticism at all. I'd really like to state something though, which I hope everyone understands:
NYKRA is my first ever 'big' full game, and the path was random and unplanned. During this time I had to learn everything on the fly, which means NYKRA still has code and art from when I was a beginner. So it's hard to know how to feel reading people's opinions on things because I'm right here with you. I'm looking at past me going "... Why did you do it like that?". But, you see that's where I'm going with this. Even if NYKRA's story is not exactly what I'd want today, it's exactly what 15 year-old me wanted. And recently I realised this. I'm embarrassed at how it released, but I'm proud that I managed to stay true to the source material.

Either way, I'm very grateful for everyone who likes NYKRA for what it is, and in some ways what it isn't too.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32837292/62f181343546a0c2c80c569e919afaa85a759e3f.png[/img]
I just can't wait to use all I now know to make something new. I found that I really enjoy making tools than tools in some ways, and I've always wanted to make my own pixelart editor. Follow me on GitHub if you'd like to chime in: [url=https://github.com/ENDESGA]https://github.com/ENDESGA[/url]

///////

This patch of NYKRA finally fixes the room issues and chapter crashes, making it possible to finally see the ending. So please use the Chapter select to jump to the chapter you were at ~!

o-------

[h2][i][u][strike]Hopefully[/strike] Fixed Issues:[/u][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]Book at left of Stronghold broke
[*]Gamepad wasn't functional
[*]Unable to get to Chapter 7
[*]A million tiny game breaking issues left by younger me
[*]More typo fixes
[/list]

[h2][i][u]Change/Additionlog:[/u][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Chapter music upon Chapter Announcement
[*]Added extra rooms to the left of Irnem's Boldemo
[*]Expanded the final Chapter and redid animations
[*]Added additional dialogue to a few scenes
[/list]

[h2][i][u]Notable Crashes:[/u][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]Some books still break the game somehow
[/list]

-------o

Thank you so much,
and remember; you are alive, you are never alone.

-EDG

notes.title: >PATCH_5
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]Kalpel![/b][/i][/h1]
After PATCH_4 I had a few days break to come back down to Earth after all the intensity the release brought. It allowed me to come back with a fresh mind, and fix some of the most annoying issues.

As I've explained a few times on Twitter, unfortunately some of the major bugs in the game revolve around code that I poorly made when I was younger - so it's been a real pain!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32837292/6ddde20c93a3ac6770ad91ffe36aa2d5a55f8067.png[/img]
(No comments either, so I have to spend ages going through to even understand what's going on. Comment your code please! Future you will thank you)

PATCH_6 is hoping to finally fix the last few progression-breaking bugs, along with gamepad support. I'm gonna also try to export it to macOS - as much as I hate Apple...

o-------

[h2][i][u][strike]Hopefully[/strike] Fixed Issues:[/u][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]Aenox terminal in the [spoiler]VEN room[/spoiler] constantly broke
[*]Loading old saves broke (can still break!)
[*]Certain objects with temporary variables got saved by accident, causing crashes
[*]All the tiny little errors that people in the NYKRA Discord found
[*]More typo fixes
[/list]

[h2][i][u]Change/Additionlog:[/u][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]Added some extra music to rooms that were too silent
[*]Added LOK and DOR, 2 npc characters who guard Moriiem
[/list]

[h2][i][u]Notable Crashes:[/u][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]The first rooms on planet Irnem are broken
[*][spoiler]Accessing Pod 7 within Moriiem crashes the game[/spoiler]
[/list]

-------o

Thank you all for staying with me on this journey! It was a rough launch, but I appreciate everyone who believes in me <3

-EDG

notes.title: >PATCH_3
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]Kalpel![/b][/i][/h1]
The aftereffects of the release have decided to finally hit my body it seems: as I woke up this morning feeling like I've aged 70 years. But after a quick walk around the block in my small city in New Zealand (any kiwis here?), I managed to recover somewhat before starting on today's bug list.

My list is in an order of priority, so I've really only been able to spend all my time on things like the save system - which desperately needed to be fixed.
Save files from previous patches should work now, and saving and loading the game in general should be less problematic. NYKRA's save system is really odd - and I don't know why past me decided it was a good idea to save everything in compressed chars, rather than something legible and easily debuggable... Anyway, it hopefully works now.

Though, I did manage to quickly fix the middle room in this part of the story.

notes.title: >PATCH_2
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]Kalpel![/b][/i][/h1]
Well, what an intense couple of days! I've been really trying my best to keep up with everything, but there's just so much! Thank you all for the support. I know it's been initially rough, but I have plans!

So the launch didn't go to plan, because Steam unfortunately messed up the visibility of the game (in fact, as of writing this, it's still not visible in Australia). It's getting sorted asap, and I appreciate the patience - as always.

This patch was meant to be beefy, but I encountered a series of issues that ended up taking a solid 6 hours of work to untangle. The save system seems to be a lot more broken than I thought, which is deeply frustrating, because it was tested a LOT during the beta testing. Regardless, it's mostly functional again now, and your books won't disappear when reopening the game! It also fixes a few other important things when reopening a save file.
Speaking of save files, I should have mentioned that they're hiding in your %appdata%\Roaming\NYKRA folder! You may need to either start a new save file, or wait until things are fully fixed. Because I was not expecting this to happen.

Though, I will be providing drop-in save files at each Chapter start so you can continue the story where you left off. I will be providing probably tomorrow!
I'm so sorry if you lost your progress! I have many things planned to make it easy for you to continue the story, so stay tuned!

o-------

[h2][i][u][strike]Hopefully[/strike] Fixed Issues:[/u][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]Windowed mode did not work. Game now starts in Windowed
[*]Books disappeared on game load
[*]Starting new Chapters caused crashes
[*]More uncountable amount of tiny little fixes and tweaks
[/list]

[h2][i][u]Change/Additionlog:[/u][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]Adjusted some dialogue
[/list]

[h2][i][u]Notable Crashes:[/u][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]There are still certain rooms that are disconnected - causing crashes
[*][spoiler]Accessing Pod 7 within Moriiem crashes the game[/spoiler]
[*]Planet Mexulta sometimes breaks the camera (?) Which then crashes things
[/list]

-------o

I'm hoping to have a fully stable build by the start of the weekend. This is also when it'll be releasing on itch.io as well.
Thanks so much for coming with me on this journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32837292/9bc96f11c614a45bb1e5429bab5249fa4c98056f.jpg[/img]
(by [url=https://twitter.com/dlljs/status/1442870525198417935/photo/1]@dlljs on Twitter[/url])

-EDG

notes.title: >PATCH_1
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]Kalpel![/b][/i][/h1]
EDG here - haven't done this before, so you'll have to bear with the highly-likely chance of mishap. I hope this is the best place to post what's important!

This initial phase of NYKRA was bound to be rocky, but I'm going to do my best to keep up with the bug reports.
I'll be updating the game at least every 12 hours, because if I don't pace myself I'll disintegrate into ash.
I'll also try to keep things [i]SPOILER SAFE![/i]

o-------

[h2][i][u][strike]Hopefully[/strike] Fixed Issues:[/u][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]Switching to fullscreen via the Esc menu crashed the game
[*]The Aenox Terminal in the [spoiler]VEN room[/spoiler] caused a softlock
[*]Keu glitched through the floor [i]sometimes [/i]on corners
[*]Books still annoyingly get deleted upon savefile-load, but the lack of them crashed the game
[*]Uncountable amount of tiny little fixes and tweaks
[/list]

[h2][i][u]Changelog:[/u][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed the intro splash.
[/list]

[h2][i][u]Notable Crashes:[/u][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*]There are certain rooms that are disconnected - causing crashes
[*][spoiler]Closing the game at points during Chapter 2 causes crashes[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Accessing Pod 7 within Moriiem crashes the game[/spoiler]
[*]Lots of softlocks accessing Aenox objects
[/list]

-------o

I really appreciate all the patience! The response has been overwhelming to say the least, but it's been such a good feeling to at least have this insane thing on Steam.

I'll be back soon!
-EDG
